talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.tyrant: You look soft. %s says I put you on the ground. Or are you a coward as well?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.noble: Would you care for a friendly bout? %s on it, all in good sport.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.warlord: You carry yourself like a fighter. A bout, %s to the winner. Let's see what you've got.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.paranoid: You. Show me how you fight. %s on it. I want to know what you're capable of.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reveler: A wrestle! Best of one! %s, and the loser buys the next round!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.plain: Fancy a bout? %s says I'll have you on your back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.tyrant.more: Hands and feet, no blades. If you win, I'll be surprised. Put up %s or walk on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.noble.more: Bare hands, first to yield. %s each, and no hard feelings, whoever wins.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.warlord.more: Bare hands, first one down loses. %s. Better armour helps, so does a strong arm.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.paranoid.more: A bout, %s. If you're an assassin, I'd rather find out now than later.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reveler.more: No weapons, just a friendly scrap! %s! Everyone's watching, come on!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.plain.more: No weapons. %s. Armour and a strong arm will help you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.purist: Let's see what %2$s blood is good for. %1$s says you go down.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.purist_kin: A bout between kin? %1$s, and let the best of us win.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.purist.more: Bare hands. %1$s. I want everyone to watch %3$s blood beat yours.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.purist_kin.more: Bare hands, first down loses, %1$s. No hard feelings between our blood.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.won.tyran: Ugh... Take your %s and get out of my sight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.won.warlo: Ha! Now that's a fighter! %s, and my respect.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.won.paran: Hm. Good. %s. I'll know to watch your left hand.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.won.revel: Ooh, my back! Brilliant! Here's your %s!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.won.puris: ...A fluke. %s. Don't let it go to your head.
Ha! That's our blood! %s, well earned.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.lost.tyra: Down in the dirt, where you belong. Your %s are mine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.lost.nobl: Good effort. I'll take the %s, but you fought well.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.lost.warl: Not bad. Not good enough. %s. Come back when you've trained.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.lost.para: Weak. Good. %s. You're no threat to anyone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.lost.reve: Hahaha! On your back! Thanks for the %s!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.lost.puri: As expected. %s. Your kind always ends up on the ground.
Up you get, kinsman. %s. You'll have me next time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.decline.w: Afraid of a little scrap? Pathetic.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.decline.p: Not even to prove you're harmless? Interesting.
Of course not. No backbone in your blood.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.insult.ty: A dog, am I? Let's see you say it with a blade in your gut!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.insult.no: That was uncalled for. Good day.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.insult.wa: Draw, then. You'll eat those words.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.insult.pa: So that's what you are. Draw!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.insult.re: Ha! Grumpy! Have a drink, you need it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.insult.pu: You dare? I'll teach you your place!
Watch your tongue, kinsman. I'll let that one go.
